text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
*European Commissioners guaranted that Portugal will receive money from the Cohesion Fund after 2000, although the exact amount has no yet been established.
*The newspaper quotes Spanish newspaper Cinco Dias as saying Spain's Caixa da Galicia is negotiating to buy the Portuguese branch of Credit Lyonnais.
*European Commissioner Emma Bonino wants a probe into Portuguese imports of beef from Britain.

*Oil company Petrogal and gas company Gas de Portugal will not make a joint bid in privatisation of Brazilian gas companies Rio Gas and CEG. But Gas de Portugal is still interested in taking part, sources from the two Portuguese compaies said.
*According to Eurostat, Portugal registered the lowest energy consumption among the countries of the European Union in 1996.

*Electricity group EDP -Electricidade de Portugal is going to be restructured in the autumn: it will merge four regional companies responsible for distribution of the energy, a company source told the paper. Some 2,500 jobs may go.
*Portugal Telecom will make a commercial agreement with danish TeleDanmark, which may take a 1.25 percent stake in the company. Paper gives no sources for information.
